evidence.label: EXPLAIN
evidence.quote: Git config is a command which is used to give details, give your details to the Git tool.

evidence.label: DEMONSTRATE
evidence.quote: you have to give git config space hyphen hyphen global ... user.name and in double quotes, you can give your name.

evidence.label: ASK_WHY
evidence.quote: Okay, so why do I need to give my details?

evidence.label: REAL_WORLD_APP
evidence.quote: to keep track of those changes, to know who has done that particular change, your Git has to know your information.
